findings: fix: CLM-15 "Week 2 · still in the routine"

alignment.name: tone & language rules
alignment.why: No tone or language rule hits (TON-*, LNG-*) and nothing against the brand's stated philosophy. Other policy findings count in compliance, not here.

alignment.name: Meta voice match
alignment.why: Measured against 10 long-running brand copies and 8 top statics (meta_voice_profile.json, built 2026-10-05): sentence length 100 — median 6 words per sentence vs the brand's 7 (middle half 4–9); exclamation marks 100 — 0 per 100 words vs the brand's 0.6; emoji 100 — 0 per 100 words vs the brand's 0.6; hype words 100 — none (0/100 words vs the brand's 0.2); fear / problem words 100 — none (0/100 words vs the brand's 0.4); ingredient / % first 100 — opens with an active or a concentration (as the brand does in 37% of its openers); hook type 100 — opening hook reads as "ingredient led" (20% of the brand's long-running copies).

alignment.name: transparency & no exaggeration
alignment.why: shows the active's strength, as the brand does.

alignment.name: on-image text budget
alignment.why: 27 words on the image (brand's single statics: 13 median, 21 max; limit used 36), headline 10 word(s). Over budget: footnote 156 characters (about 2 lines max). Counts words only; layout, white space and product size are not seen by this score.

alignment.name: AI judge tone read
alignment.why: Calm and evidence-led: the headline leads with a consumer-study result in the brand's perception wording rather than a fear hook or hype, and the usage line is precise. The Day 1 / Week 2 frames, though, borrow the category's transformation-story format, which is not how Minimalist presents proof.

win.name: format / template
win.why: Format "Split-screen transformation" (given (ctx.template_id)): 3 of 4 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 67% of 122). Shrunk towards that base rate; small group, read as a direction only.

win.name: text density on the image
win.why: 27 words on the image (21–35 words; headline + on-image text, footnote not counted): 19 of 27 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 80% of 74). Shrunk towards that base rate.

win.name: offer on the image
win.why: No offer on the image: 54 of 69 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 67% of 122). Shrunk towards that base rate.

win.name: stat / number claim on the image
win.why: Leads with a stat or number: 9 of 10 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 80% of 74). Shrunk towards that base rate; small group, read as a direction only.

win.name: CTA drawn on the image
win.why: No CTA drawn on the image (Meta's button only): 46 of 59 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 80% of 74). Shrunk towards that base rate.

win.name: person in the image
win.why: Shows a person (given (ctx.has_person)): 14 of 19 comparable statics ran 30+ days (all statics with this feature known: 67% of 122). Shrunk towards that base rate.
